proposed.explanation: The profit belonging to Talaat Moustafa's own shareholders (Shareholders of the Parent Company) grew from 9,025,066,065 EGP in 2024 to 14,383,890,306 EGP in 2025, which is an increase of approximately 59.38%. Furthermore, consolidated net profit for the year reached 18,201,981,482 EGP in 2025 compared to 12,769,517,325 EGP in 2024, and earnings per share rose from 4.38 EGP to 6.98 EGP. While this strong performance demonstrates solid financial growth aligning with your long-term growth goal, adding new shares must respect the portfolio diversification rule which mandates that no single company may exceed 50% of the total portfolio value. Your current portfolio consists of 500 TMGH shares valued at 82.50 EGP each (totaling 41,250.00 EGP) and 30,000.00 EGP in cash, resulting in a total portfolio value of 71,250.00 EGP. TMGH currently represents 41,250 / 71,250 = 57.89% of your portfolio, which already exceeds the 50% single-company limit. Therefore, you cannot buy additional shares at this time, and a hold action is appropriate for your existing holding.
